title: Northbeam TechWorks Cover Liaison: How Much of a Gross Figure Is Rebilled
content:
How much of the gross figure on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job is rebilled to the customer is read from the Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plans covering the item: the plan's standing, the decision recorded against its claim, what it has already paid out on the item and the per-claim limit it carries.

**Where the plan covering the item stands active and the decision recorded against its claim refused the claim**, the whole of the gross figure is rebilled, to the extent of the per-claim limit the plan carries, because a claim never asks the plan for more than that limit.

**Where the plan covering the item stands active and the decision recorded against its claim approved a repair**, nothing is rebilled.

**Where neither situation holds**, the gross figure less what the plan has already paid out on the item, held to the per-claim limit the plan carries, is rebilled, and never below nothing.

Where no plan stands active on the item there is no per-claim limit and no refused claim, so nothing is rebilled under this rule at all.

## The readings side by side

| The plan covering the item | The decision recorded against its claim | The figure rebilled |
| --- | --- | --- |
| standing active | refused the claim | the whole gross figure, held to the per-claim limit |
| standing active | approved a repair | nothing |
| standing active | any other outcome recorded | the gross figure less the payouts already made on the item, held to the per-claim limit, never below nothing |
| not standing active | any | nothing, there being no per-claim limit |

A decision that approved a replacement, approved a reimbursement or was withdrawn by the customer is neither a refusal nor an approved repair, so it falls to the third line.

## Illustrations on hypothetical jobs

**A refused claim, a gross figure inside the limit.** The gross figure is 297.50 USD and the plan carries a per-claim limit of 500.00 USD. The whole of the gross figure is rebilled: 297.50 USD.

**A refused claim, a gross figure above the limit.** The gross figure is 1,200.00 USD against a per-claim limit of 500.00 USD. The figure rebilled is 500.00 USD.

**A claim on which a repair was approved.** Nothing is rebilled, whatever the gross figure.

**A replacement approved, with payouts already made.** The gross figure is 297.50 USD and 100.00 USD has already been paid out on the item, against a per-claim limit of 500.00 USD. The figure rebilled is 197.50 USD.

**No plan standing active on the item.** Nothing is rebilled.
